title: DIR Stage A screened logical record
description: Typed dir-screening-v9 logical row. Stage A records source linkage separately from manual semantic correspondence. Methodology dir-tfg-v2.

source_case_id.description: Case identifier in the PatchPrompt candidate index.

conversation_id.description: Share identifier extracted from a valid conversation URL.

conversation_url.description: Original conversation URL from the source index, including invalid values for excluded rows.

repository.description: Owner and repository parsed from the source PR URL.

pr_number.description: PR number parsed from the source PR URL.

pr_url.description: Original PR URL from the source index, retained even when invalid.

canonical_pr_url.description: Canonical GitHub PR URL returned by the verified PR source.

pr_redirect_verified.description: Whether the GitHub API redirect passed identity verification.

Outcome_Class.description: Candidate population class from the source index.

C_score.description: Inherited PatchPrompt Context score, not supplied Context.

S_score.description: Inherited PatchPrompt Specificity score, not supplied Specificity.

V_score.description: Inherited PatchPrompt Verification score, not supplied Verification.

conversation_available.description: Whether the complete visible conversation is processable.

temporal_anchor_available.description: Whether the conversation start supplies a usable temporal anchor.

first_generation_boundary_identifiable.description: Preliminary Stage A processability judgment; Stage C identifies the boundary authoritatively.

source_linkage_status.description: Stage A administrative source/provenance linkage state; it does not prove semantic task correspondence.

source_linkage_source.description: Administrative provenance used to establish or assess the source PR/conversation association.

source_linkage_reason.description: Reason for a conflicting or unresolved source linkage; blank when established.

pr_conversation_match.description: Stage A manual judgment whether permitted evidence supports that the conversation and PR concern the same development task.

duplicate_status.description: Duplicate relationship found by Stage A source identity checks.

project_history_accessible.description: Administrative Git history access judgment, separate from PR API retrieval.

historical_state_reconstructible.description: Scientific historical-state processability judgment, distinct from present Git access.

processability_source.description: Source of general processability judgments, when reviewed.

eligible.description: True for confirmed eligible, false for excluded, null for pending.

pr_conversation_match_source.description: Method or restricted packet source for the Stage A manual correspondence judgment.

pr_conversation_match_reviewer.description: Stage A manual reviewer or process identifier.

pr_conversation_match_timestamp.description: Timezone-aware Stage A manual review timestamp.

pr_conversation_match_version.description: Version of the Stage A manual review record.

pr_conversation_match_evidence_ref.description: Auditable reference to the restricted Stage A review evidence.

pr_conversation_match_reason.description: Concise rationale for the Stage A correspondence judgment.

project_history_access_mechanism.description: Mechanism used for administrative history access probe.

project_history_access_repository.description: Repository tested by the history access probe.

project_history_access_object.description: Known PR base commit object tested by the history access probe.

project_history_access_source.description: Source of the tested Git object identifier.

project_history_access_reason.description: Failure or unresolved explanation from the access probe.

stage_b_readiness_status.description: Operational packaging status. Ready includes scientifically eligible cases and pending cases whose only unresolved conditions are explicitly deferred to Stage C/tFG.

stage_b_readiness_reason.description: Deterministic reason for readiness or the explicit pre-Stage-B blockers.

case_integrity_status.description: Structural identity and duplicate check result, not task correspondence.

duplicate_of.description: Neutral Case ID of first duplicate row.

conversation_start.description: First developer prompt date or timestamp, without fabricated precision.

conversation_retrieval_status.description: Public or archive conversation retrieval result.

pr_retrieval_status.description: GitHub PR/API retrieval result, not Git history access.

changed_files.description: Count of unique PR diff paths, descriptive only.

pr_commits.description: PR commit count from PR source, descriptive only.

developer_prompts.description: Number of visible developer turns in complete conversation.

assistant_responses.description: Number of visible assistant replies in complete conversation.

conversation_words.description: Word count of complete visible conversation.

conversation_turn_pattern.description: Descriptive developer-turn count category, never a decision or retrieval cue.
